name: Corner Logo
description: A logo of any shape fitted in a square box in a chosen corner; it fades and rises in, and fades out by the end.

controls.name: Logo
controls.description: The logo picture, any shape (a PNG with transparency works best), fitted inside the Size box and centred. Default: a sample mark.

controls.name: Corner
controls.description: Which corner of the frame the logo sits in.

controls.name: Size
controls.description: Side of the square box the logo fits inside, in pixels.

controls.name: Margin
controls.description: Distance from the box to the frame's two edges, in pixels.

controls.name: Opacity
controls.description: How solid the logo is once it has faded in, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Fade
controls.description: Fade In and Out; Fade In (then full to the end: a video's first photo); Steady (full throughout: the photos between); Fade Out (full from the first frame: the last photo).

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When it starts to fade and rise in, in seconds (0.5 s in); not used by Steady and Fade Out.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; with Fade In and Out or Fade Out the logo fades out over its last 0.5 s.
